structure: PRIMARY picks the name and the window; the desk's %R trigger (pre-square, evening_family.presquare_bars) is SECONDARY timing inside that window; the exit is sized to the name.

primaries (three groups, scored separate.NEWS: the name's first Alpaca news story of the day (07:00-15:59; pre-open stories count from 09:30) is at most 30 minutes before the trigger minute (window widened from the 15 min said in chat to 30, before any data, so the group can reach the power bar)
primaries (three groups, scored separate.VOL: volume pace: volume of the last 15 closed minutes / (mean daily volume of the name's prior 5 warehouse days x 15/390) >= 3.0
primaries (three groups, scored separate.BOTH: NEWS and VOL at the same minute

universe_and_band: SIP warehouse top-400 names, $20-$400 and up >= 1.5% vs prior close at the trigger minute, minutes 15-330 (room for the 60-minute hold)
entry: the FIRST %R trigger bar in a primary-active minute, per name per day per group; enter at the open of the next minute
exit: ATR = mean (high - low) of the 15 closed minutes before entry; stop = entry - 2 ATR, target = entry + 4 ATR (stop first if one minute touches both); else the close of the 60th minute
cost: the real SIP quoted spread in the 60 s before entry (news_source.fetch_quotes), subtracted once as the round-trip cost (row 152: cost = spread); events with no quote are dropped and counted
sample: all events if a group-period has <= 4,000; otherwise the 4,000 with the lowest sha256('catalyst'|day|sym|t)

pass_each_group (Bonferroni for 3 groups.edge: mean net >= +2.0 bp after the real spread
pass_each_group (Bonferroni for 3 groups.both_halves: mean net > 0 in the first and the second half of the days

information_only: 9/24-11/17; each group with NO %R (enter at the first primary-active minute) to show whether %R adds; the desk's fixed +20/-50 bracket on the same events; gross before spread; median spread
if_pass: result-skeptic review, then a separate paper lane behind a default-off switch, replayed through the live code, then on under the operator's 11/18 rule
if_fail: record; the catalyst-primary + %R-secondary structure is closed at this horizon on SIP bars
